defs: def sdl: [.assets | to_entries[] | select(.key | startswith("schemas/")) | .value] | join("\n"); def fields($type): sdl | [capture("type " + $type + "(\\s[^{]*)?\\{(?<b>[^}]*)\\}").b | split("\n")[] | select(test("^\\s*[a-z_]+:")) ]; def names($type): fields($type) | map(capture("^\\s*(?<n>[a-z_]+):").n); def header($type): sdl | capture("(?<h>type " + $type + "(\\s[^{]*)?)\\{").h; def gate: .config.callbacks[] | select(.callback_id == "claim-gate"); def surface: .config.datastore_tool_surfaces[] | select(.surface_id == "claim-graph-writes") | (.entries | if type == "object" then .entries else . end); def entry($t): surface[] | select(.tool_name == $t); def required: [.fields[] | select(.required == true) | .name] | sort; def profile: .assets["profiles/research.json"] | fromjson;

jq.name: every scalar schema field is immutable (DefraDB refuses @immutable on a list)
jq.expr: . as $d | ["Claim", "Edge", "Entity", "Perspective", "ClaimGraph", "ClaimBatch", "GateReceipt", "ExportRequest", "ExportReceipt", "ViewRequest", "ViewReceipt"] | all(. as $t | ($d | fields($t)) as $f | ($f | length) > 0 and ($f | all(test(": \\[") or test("@immutable")))) and ([$d | fields("Claim"), fields("Entity"), fields("ClaimGraph") | map(select(test(": \\["))) | length] == [1, 1, 7])

jq.name: the manifest declares exactly the eleven schema files
every schema carries an indexed immutable graph_id
jq.expr: . as $d | ["Claim", "Edge", "Entity", "Perspective", "ClaimGraph", "ClaimBatch", "GateReceipt", "ExportRequest", "ExportReceipt", "ViewRequest", "ViewReceipt"] | all(. as $t | $d | fields($t) | any(test("^\\s*graph_id: String @index @immutable$")))

jq.name: graph rows and profile versions are unique per graph, not globally
jq.expr: . as $d | [["Claim", "claim_id"], ["Edge", "edge_key"], ["Entity", "entity_id"], ["Perspective", "perspective_id"], ["ClaimGraph", "version"]] | all(. as [$t, $k] | ($d | header($t) | contains("@index(fields: [\"graph_id\", \"" + $k + "\"], unique: true)")) and ($d | fields($t) | map(select(test("^\\s*" + $k + ":"))) | length == 1 and all(test("unique") | not)))

jq.name: the gate callback emits one receipt, four row ports and the profile port, correlated by batch_id
jq.expr: gate | .handler | (.plugin | IN("claim_gate", "gents/claim_gate")) and .correlation_field == "batch_id" and (.outputs | map({name, collection, cardinality, required: (.required // false)}) == [{name: "receipt", collection: "GateReceipt", cardinality: "one", required: true}, {name: "claims", collection: "Claim", cardinality: "many", required: false}, {name: "edges", collection: "Edge", cardinality: "many", required: false}, {name: "entities", collection: "Entity", cardinality: "many", required: false}, {name: "perspectives", collection: "Perspective", cardinality: "many", required: false}, {name: "profile", collection: "ClaimGraph", cardinality: "one", required: false}]) and (.outputs | all(.correlation_field == "batch_id" and .schema == (.collection + "/v1")))

jq.name: every gate output collection has a schema with a batch_id field
jq.expr: . as $d | gate | .handler.outputs | all(.collection as $c | $d | fields($c) | any(test("^\\s*batch_id:")))

jq.name: the gate fires on created ClaimBatch documents and is bound to every ClaimBatch field
jq.expr: . as $d | (.config.event_sources[] | select(.event_source_id == "claim-batch") | .source_collection == "ClaimBatch" and .event_kind == "created" and .correlation_field == "batch_id") and (.config.callback_bindings[] | select(.binding_id == "claim-gate") | .event_source_id == "claim-batch" and (.input_fields | sort) == ($d | names("ClaimBatch") | sort))

jq.name: the gate, export and views plugins may only query the graph collections and profiles
jq.expr: [.manifest.plugins[] | {key: .name, value: .data}] | from_entries == {claim_gate: {collections: ["Claim", "Edge", "Entity", "Perspective", "ClaimGraph"], ops: ["query"]}, claim_export: {collections: ["Claim", "Edge", "Entity", "Perspective", "ClaimGraph"], ops: ["query"]}, claim_views: {collections: ["Claim", "Edge", "Entity", "Perspective", "ClaimGraph"], ops: ["query"]}}

jq.name: the gate reads source_root; export and views write out_dir
jq.expr: .manifest.plugins | (map(select(.name == "claim_gate"))[0].bind_dir | .input_field == "source_root" and .access == "read") and (map(select(.name == "claim_export" or .name == "claim_views")) | length == 2 and all(.bind_dir | .input_field == "out_dir" and .access == "read_write" and .original_field == "out_dir_original"))

jq.name: every plugin input names the graph, and a view is one of the three
jq.expr: .manifest.plugins | all(.input_schema.properties.graph_id.type == "string") and (map(select(.name == "claim_views"))[0].input_schema | .properties.view.enum == ["status", "disputes", "reputation"] and (.required | sort) == ["graph_id", "request_id", "view"] and (.properties | keys | sort) == ["dry_run", "graph_id", "out_dir", "out_dir_original", "request_id", "view"])

jq.name: the SME queries the graph, profiles and receipts, writes only through its surface, and may export
jq.expr: .config.tools[] | select(.tools_id == "claim-sme-tools") | .datastore.enable_defra_query == true and (.datastore.defra_query_collections | sort) == ["Claim", "ClaimGraph", "Edge", "Entity", "ExportReceipt", "GateReceipt", "Perspective", "ViewReceipt"] and .datastore.datastore_tool_surface_ids == ["claim-graph-writes"] and (.datastore.write_collections // [] | length == 0) and (.integrations.plugins | map(.plugin)) == ["gents/claim_export"]

jq.name: file_claims creates a ClaimBatch for one graph with optional edges and no source_root or profile
jq.expr: ([surface[].tool_name] | sort) == ["file_claims", "request_view"] and (entry("file_claims") | .collection == "ClaimBatch" and required == ["batch_id", "claims", "graph_id", "section"] and ([.fields[].name] | index("edges") != null and index("source_root") == null and index("profile") == null and index("entities") == null and index("perspectives") == null))

jq.name: request_view creates a ViewRequest for one graph without a folder
jq.expr: entry("request_view") | .collection == "ViewRequest" and required == ["graph_id", "request_id", "view"] and ([.fields[].name] | index("out_dir") == null)

jq.name: the agent uses the sme slot and its context
jq.expr: (.config.agents | map({agent_id, context_id, inference_profile_id})) == [{agent_id: "claim-sme", context_id: "claim-sme-context", inference_profile_id: "gents:inference-slot:sme"}] and (.manifest.inference_slots | map({name, agents})) == [{name: "sme", agents: ["claim-sme"]}] and (.config.contexts[] | select(.context_id == "claim-sme-context") | .tools_id == "claim-sme-tools")

jq.name: the prompt names the tools, the graph scope and the status rule's edge types
jq.expr: .assets["agent_behaviors/claim_sme/system_prompt.md"] as $d0 | ($d0 | contains("file_question") | not) and (["file_claims", "request_view", "ClaimGraph", "graph_id", "retracts", "supersedes", "contradicts", "challenges", "answers", "resolves", "reviews", "challenged", "entity_text", "ViewReceipt"] | all(. as $w | $d0 | contains($w)))

jq.name: the research profile holds exactly the profile fields and the dispute vocabulary
jq.expr: . as $d | profile | (keys | sort) == ($d | names("ClaimGraph") - ["graph_id", "version", "batch_id", "created_at"] | sort) and (["question", "challenge", "review"] - .kinds == []) and (["answers", "challenges", "reviews", "resolves", "supersedes", "retracts", "contradicts"] - .edge_types == []) and .review_verdicts == ["sustains", "weakens", "unclear"] and .resolver_perspectives == ["p:mike"] and .mapping_targets == ["defradb", "fefra"] and .question_entity == "e:open-question" and .questions_from_prefix == "graph/claims/questions.jsonl" and .claim_id_pattern == "^c:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{3}$" and .text_max_words == 40 and ([.kinds, .confidence_classes, .edge_types, .mapping_targets, .mapping_fits, .review_verdicts] | all(length > 0 and (unique | length) == length))

jq.name: the import tool, prompt and README carry no em or en dash
an ExportRequest runs claim_export as a callback with one required ExportReceipt port
jq.expr: . as $d | (.config.callbacks[] | select(.callback_id == "claim-export") | .handler | (.plugin | IN("claim_export", "gents/claim_export")) and .correlation_field == "request_id" and (.outputs | map({name, collection, cardinality, required, correlation_field}) == [{name: "receipt", collection: "ExportReceipt", cardinality: "one", required: true, correlation_field: "request_id"}])) and (.config.event_sources[] | select(.event_source_id == "export-request") | .source_collection == "ExportRequest" and .event_kind == "created" and .correlation_field == "request_id") and (.config.callback_bindings[] | select(.binding_id == "claim-export") | .callback_id == "claim-export" and .event_source_id == "export-request" and .input_fields == ["request_id", "graph_id", "out_dir", "sections", "dry_run"]) and ($d | names("ExportReceipt") | index("request_id") != null)

jq.name: a ViewRequest runs claim_views as a callback with one required ViewReceipt port
jq.expr: . as $d | (.config.callbacks[] | select(.callback_id == "claim-views") | .handler | (.plugin | IN("claim_views", "gents/claim_views")) and .correlation_field == "request_id" and (.outputs | map({name, collection, cardinality, required, correlation_field, schema}) == [{name: "receipt", collection: "ViewReceipt", cardinality: "one", required: true, correlation_field: "request_id", schema: "ViewReceipt/v1"}])) and (.config.event_sources[] | select(.event_source_id == "view-request") | .source_collection == "ViewRequest" and .event_kind == "created" and .correlation_field == "request_id") and (.config.callback_bindings[] | select(.binding_id == "claim-views") | .callback_id == "claim-views" and .event_source_id == "view-request" and .input_fields == ["request_id", "graph_id", "view", "out_dir", "dry_run"]) and ($d | names("ViewReceipt") | index("request_id") != null) and ($d | names("ViewRequest") | sort) == (["request_id", "graph_id", "view", "out_dir", "dry_run", "note", "submitted_at"] | sort)
